evidence: Sen. Ira 2.22.2: Dandum semper est tempus: vēritātem diēs aperit.
terms.comment: Literally “time uncovers the truth”: Seneca’s advice not to believe a charge at once.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
